products.title: Time Stopper Anti-Ageing Face Cream
products.descriptionHtml:
Time Stopper Anti-Ageing Face Cream is built around one simple idea — skin that is well fed, well hydrated and well protected looks younger for longer. Two signal peptides, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 and Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, sit at the heart of the formula, supported by Centella Asiatica stem cells, sodium hyaluronate and green tea leaf extract.

The texture is rich but never heavy. It melts in with a few upward strokes, leaves no sticky film and settles beautifully under sunscreen in the morning or on its own at night.

What the formula brings to your skin

  • Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 & Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 — signal peptides for visibly firmer, smoother-looking skin
  • Centella Asiatica Stem Cells — the classic cica soother for stressed, easily sensitised skin
  • Sodium Hyaluronate — lightweight hyaluronic acid that holds moisture in the surface layers
  • Squalane & Caprylic Capric Triglyceride — soft emollients that seal in water for a supple finish
  • Caffeine — helps tired, puffy-looking skin read fresher
  • Green Tea Leaf Extract & Vitamin E — antioxidants against everyday pollution stress
  • Baobab Seed Extract, Rice Amino Acids & Hydrolyzed Soy Protein — plant proteins for a bouncy, well-nourished look
  • D-Panthenol & Allantoin — barrier-friendly conditioners that keep skin calm

Who it is for

  • Anyone in their late twenties and beyond who is seeing the first fine lines
  • Dry, dull or tired-looking skin that needs more than a basic moisturiser
  • Men and women alike — one cream, morning and night

Formulated with no parabens and no added fragrance. Made in India at an ISO 9001:2015 and GMP certified facility. Net quantity 50 g.
